issue.title: bob-cli CI lint fails: coordination acceptance self-test pre-sync commit has no git identity on the runner

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
bob-cli master CI run 40022536991 (7e3bdb2e) fails the lint job at `just check-scripts`, the
same node that failed run 40018189915 (134016ce). CI has failed on two consecutive commits.
The self-test's scratch vault pre-sync runs `git commit`, and the GitHub runner has no git
identity:

```
highlights-coordination-acceptance: FAIL: intake drain failed
... xlib/chat/seed.pdf (pre-sync failed: git commit failed: Author identity unknown
fatal: empty ident name (for <runner@...>) not allowed)
recipe `check-scripts` failed on line 44 with exit code 1
```

Locally `just check` passes because athena has a global git identity. 7e3bdb2e (bob-cli-at
landing) fixed the earlier pandoc dependency of the same self-test, but not the identity.
Root cause: the script's own git calls pass identity with
`-c user.email=acceptance@example.com -c user.name="Acceptance Kit"` (lines ~133-153), but
`bob`'s internal vault-sync pre-sync commit inside the scratch vault reads only repo, global,
or system config. The CI runner has none, and its passwd entry has an empty GECOS name.
Athena's GECOS name supplies a fallback, so the failure does not reproduce there even with
`GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null` (verified 2026-10-23: exit 0). Fix: after `git init`, persist
the scratch identity in the vault (`git -C "$vault" config user.name "Acceptance Kit"` and
`user.email`). Confirm on CI.

The other lint warnings in that job are bob-cli-v's preexisting clippy warnings, not the
failure. The ubuntu, macos, and package jobs passed. Introduced by epic bob-cli-at (closed)
phase .7 commit 134016ce; found by the bob-cli-an.6 lander.

issue.creation_reason: Found by the bob-cli-an.6 lander: master CI is red on two consecutive commits from the closed bob-cli-at landing, which blocks the daily release train.
